summaryDeep:
Being around this person can make you feel more confident in yourself. They may encourage you to trust your instincts, take a chance, or finally follow through on something you've been putting off. It can feel like they see what you're capable of, even when you're doubting yourself, and that makes it easier to believe in yourself too.

The energy between you can feel easy and natural. This person may encourage you without even realizing it. You might feel more confident taking action when they're around, or more willing to trust yourself instead of second-guessing everything. It can feel good to have someone who supports your momentum instead of slowing it down.

Because this flows so naturally, it can be easy to take for granted. The support is there, but it works best when you actually use it.

This is the kind of connection that grows stronger when you make plans, follow through, and build something together.
